text:
Ishita (CS): quick sync on Pelmor priv-VPC onboarding — customer reporting KMS failures from their app in the VPC. They said onboarding blockers could push renewal conversations.
Ravi (Eng-Infra): Can you paste their error and any correlation id?
Ishita (CS): from their app logs: 
```
2026-03-21T10:23:11Z ERROR kms.Client Error: 403 Forbidden - KMSAccessDenied - requestId: a1b2c3d4
Message: User arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/pelmor-app-role is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/aa11bb22-33cc-44dd-55ee-66778899ff00
```
Lina (SE): 2 likely causes: key policy denies principal or IAM role lacks kms:Decrypt. Also possible aws:sourceVpc or aws:sourceVpce condition mismatch if they use a VPC Endpoint.
Theo (SRE): They previously told us they use an interface VPC endpoint with custom endpoint policy. Do we have the endpoint id?
Ishita (CS): yes — vpce-0f9e8d7c. Customer confirms endpoint policy only allows principals from their account but they rotated roles during onboarding.
Ravi (Eng-Infra): Rotation could change the assumed-role ARN. If the key policy used a hard-coded principal ARN it'll break. Best remediation: (a) attach explicit kms permissions to the role, (b) update key policy to allow the account or a condition on aws:SourceVpc for the VPC id for a short debug window.
Lina (SE): I'll draft minimal role policy + key policy snippet. Keep it narrow to kms:Decrypt, Encrypt, GenerateDataKey.
Lina (SE): role policy (attach to pelmor-app-role):
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:Encrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/aa11bb22-33cc-44dd-55ee-66778899ff00"
    }
  ]
}
```
Lina (SE): key policy for temporary debug (allows account principals and the VPC via condition):
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "AllowAccountAndVPCE",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:root"},
      "Action": "kms:*",
      "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"aws:sourceVpc": "vpc-0a1b2c3d"}}
    }
  ]
}
```
Theo (SRE): Note: KMS key policy Condition keys for sourceVpc are supported only for AWS-managed requests; double-check. If not, use VPC endpoint policy to allow KMS actions when coming from that VPC.
Ravi (Eng-Infra): Good catch. Let's plan both: permissive account-level key policy for debug + endpoint policy tweak; then tighten. Also check CloudTrail — if KMS calls are reaching us (they are, because 403 returned) the logs will show the principal and sourceIp.
DeployBot: change set queued - key-policy-debug-3271234567 (pending approver: Ravi).
Ishita (CS): Customer asks for timeline: can we aim for a debug window tomorrow 9am PST? They want live screen share.
Ravi (Eng-Infra): I can apply the role policy tonight and the debug key policy at 06:00 PST tomorrow, then roll back after validation. Need security approval for temporary policy.
Theo (SRE): I'll monitor CloudTrail + their audit logs. After they run the decrypt test, I'll confirm the event shows kms:Decrypt allowed and that CloudTrail captured it.
Lina (SE): Test command for them to run inside the VPC (they already have AWS CLI configured):
```
aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://blob.bin --key-id alias/pelmor-key --region us-west-2
```
Ishita (CS): Also customer requested audit log forwarding to their SIEM, 1 year retention. Is that in scope of Private onboarding?
Lina (SE): We can provide sample CloudWatch Logs -> Kinesis Data Firehose config and a Terraform snippet. I'll include it in the Pelmor onboarding runbook.
Ravi (Eng-Infra): Owners: Ravi - apply role policy & coord security approval; Lina - prepare key policy + runbook + SIEM forwarding sample; Theo - audit verification during debug. Ishita - update CS renewal tracker: set renewal_risk:elevated; note expected mitigation ETA +2 days.
Ishita (CS): I'll note: renewal_risk=elevated, mitigation_plan=debug window scheduled, next_check=tomorrow 17:00 PST.
Theo (SRE): Also flag to product: if multiple customers hit KMS/VPC endpoint policy friction we should add a KB for common pitfalls (principal rotation, endpoint policy scoping).
Ravi (Eng-Infra): Agreed. I'll coordinate with Security and ping when the change set is approved.
Ishita (CS): Thanks team :pray: — keeping customer in the loop now.
